runtime.name: whisper.cpp
runtime.build: Static linking, embedded Metal library; armv8.2-a+dotprod baseline, native CPU optimizations disabled for portability.

transcription_model.name: OpenAI Whisper large-v3 Q5_0
transcription_model.notes: Full multilingual large-v3 model, quantized to five bits; French forced, beam size 5. The turbo model is not used.

build_tool.name: CMake
build_tool.notes: Build only, not distributed inside application.

audio: Apple AVFoundation system framework. No ffmpeg, Python, pip or Homebrew required at runtime. All models bundled; no network access during transcription.
